action_grain: first selected decision per exact condition_id and model arm

classification.DATA_FAIL_CLOSED: required PIT path, identity, book, or settlement evidence is missing or conflicting
classification.POLICY_ABSTAIN: complete evidence but frozen selector or duplicate-expression policy chooses no action
classification.RESEARCH_INELIGIBLE: row exists but violates the preregistered matching/evidence contract

decision_denominator: every unique fast_source_prev_no_trial_v2 event_key for Helsinki=fmi or Tokyo=jma_amedas after forward_start_utc; complete 05:50-local 10m path required

exact_token_expression.cross_rule: event.source_round_c > event.metar_running_max_round_c and event.source_cross_confirmed is true
exact_token_expression.identity_resolution: trigger_event_id is the local source-event identity; polymarket_event_id must be resolved and cross-checked with a captured Gamma /markets/{id} payload against market_id, condition_id and token_id
exact_token_expression.mapping_caveat: routine EFHK/RJTT next print and WU settlement are separately observed; terminal token PnL is scored only from exact settlement_outcomes
exact_token_expression.probability_use: selector only; never token fair value

execution_diagnostic.book_rule: first exact-token strict WS/full-ladder book at or after max(decision+5s, model_score_ready_at, identity_available_at, capture_subscription_ready_at); sweep asks for 5 shares; no mid/selected-row substitution

feature_retry_contract.retryable_failure: incomplete captured city source path only

promotion_gate.proper_score_weighting: target_date equal, then official_print_group equal, then row equal

selector.threshold_origin: fixed semantic majority threshold; not tuned on captured outcomes
